transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, honestly, my work sent me. I just... I keep forgetting things. Scheduled callbacks, work orders, even just basic follow-ups I promised people I'd handle. It’s all just piled up so much at this point. They basically told me I need to come here and get this sorted out before I lose my shot at moving up.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks?

Yeah, I really do. It happens a lot. Like, I can start looking at a digital work order, thinking I’ve got it all under control. But... maybe halfway through reading the notes, my mind just slips off to the next noise I hear, or I start thinking about the next job on my list. Then I look back down and realize I don’t even know what I just looked at.
Did you have these kinds of attention or forgetfulness problems when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. I remember being this way back in grade school, honestly, long before I had any of this job pressure to deal with. My teachers always said I was a bright kid, but... I was just constantly misplacing my papers. I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us, and they always had to remind me to actually finish my classwork.
Do these focus and forgetfulness problems also happen outside of work, like at home or in everyday life?

Yeah, it definitely happens at home, too. I mean, I'll go to the store for three things, and I'll come back with bags full of stuff but forget the actual things I went there for. Or I'll start doing the laundry, and then I'll walk into the kitchen to get a glass of water, see the mail, start sorting that, and completely forget the clothes are just sitting wet in the washer until the next day. It's just... a constant thing, really. My house is always half-finished projects.
Do you often feel restless or like you have a hard time sitting still?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel like I have to be moving all the time or anything like that. I can sit still just fine, it's just my brain that won't stay put. So physically, no, I don't feel restless.
Have you been feeling down or depressed مؤخرا?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down or depressed. I mean, it's frustrating sometimes, dealing with the forgetfulness and the scattered thoughts, but my mood is generally fine. I don't feel sad or hopeless or anything like that. Just... scattered.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?

No, not really. I don't sit around worrying about things or feeling anxious. I mean, sure, I get stressed out if I misplace my tools on a job or forget what I was supposed to go fix, but that's just because I'm frustrated with myself for messing up again. It's not like a nervous feeling or a general worry. So, no, I wouldn't say I feel anxious.
